messages:
Julie (sales): Hey team — ACME is asking for SIG evidence for the POC by EOD Wednesday. I started a question-by-question pass but need owners. Can folks pick sections? :hourglass:
Alex P.: I can take crypto/keys and network controls. Will need the KMS diagram + key rotation policy.
Maria K.: I'll own identity & access management. I have the SSO SAML metadata and our Okta setup doc.
Samir R.: I can do infra hardening + patching cadence. Where should I drop the screenshots?
Priya (security): Please upload artifacts to the shared GDrive folder (ACME/SIG/attachments). We need files named like: `acme-sig-<section>-<YYYYMMDD>.pdf` so reviewers can track versions.
Julie (sales): @Priya noted. Adding the link: https://drive.company/ACME/SIG (internal). Use the folder and set viewer perms to acme-poc@acme.com when ready.
Alex P.: Quick question about Q42 (key rotation frequency) — do we cite the policy (policy-v3.pdf) or a snippet of the KMS audit log? Which is better?
Priya (security): Both. Policy for the statement + a one-month log extract to prove practice. Redact user IDs.
devops-bot: Automated reminder: upload deadline for ACME SIG evidence is in 48 hours.
Maria K.: For IAM question set I have: SSO metadata, group-role map (CSV), and a screenshot of Okta SCIM provisioning. Uploading now.
Samir R.: Uploaded `acme-sig-infra-20260318.pdf` with patch schedule and baseline hardening script (snippet included).
Alex P.: Uploaded `acme-sig-crypto-20260318.pdf` and `kms-rotation-log-20260228.csv` (redacted). Left a short note on algorithm choices.
Priya (security): Thanks. Two blockers I see: 1) ACME requested proof of in-region data residency for EU customers — do we have an export showing region tagging for logs? 2) They want SOC2 control mapping for our dedicated offering.
Julie (sales): For the log region, @Samir can we extract a sample S3 bucket tagging report? For SOC2 mapping, I can start a cover memo and ask legal for the attestation.
Samir R.: Yes — will export S3 tagging report and a short note on data flow. ETA 2 hours.
Maria K.: FYI acme asked a follow-up on provisioning deprovision timelines. Our docs say 24h for manual request and 72h for automated offboarding. I'll include the ticket workflow link and a screenshot of the runbook.
Priya (security): Good. I reviewed the current drafts — two editorial asks: (a) remove internal ticket IDs in screenshots, (b) add a short statement on MFA enforcement for admin roles.
Alex P.: Will add the MFA statement to crypto doc.
Julie (sales): We're tracking ownership in this thread: Alex=crypto/net, Maria=IAM, Samir=infra/logs, Priya=security review. If anyone hits a blocker, ping me and I'll escalate to solutions engineering.
Priya (security): One more: ACME asked about vulnerability management cadence (Q78). Samir, can you include our monthly vuln scan summary (redacted) and the remediation SLA?
Samir R.: Yep, attaching `acme-sig-vuln-20260318.pdf`.
Julie (sales): Amazing — once all uploads are in, I'll bundle a single zip and send to ACME with a short cover email. Thanks all :clap:
devops-bot: File upload checklist: crypto, iam, infra, vuln, policies — 5/5 completed.
Julie (sales): Closing note: please keep replies short in this thread, and if you need to discuss details, DM. I'll post the final zip link here when it's sent.
